risks.title: Macroeconomic uncertainty and tariff exposure
risks.score_rationale: New tariff measures announced on imports from key sourcing markets (China, Cambodia, Vietnam, Brazil). Absence of clarity around future trade policy requires flexible supplier networks and selective pricing adjustments.

risks.title: Foreign currency volatility
risks.score_rationale: Company exposed to foreign exchange risks from international operations across EMEA, APAC, and Americas regions, impacting financial results translation.

risks.title: Retail industry structural transformation
risks.score_rationale: Structural shift toward omnichannel and DTC experiences, with traditional wholesale channels under pressure. Requires substantial investment in e-commerce, digital marketing, and customer analytics.

risks.title: High debt levels
risks.score_rationale: Company carries significant debt from recent Kurt Geiger acquisition ($403.3M) and operating credit facilities, constraining financial flexibility.

risks.title: Integration risks from Kurt Geiger acquisition
risks.score_rationale: May 2025 acquisition of Kurt Geiger ($403.3M) requires complex integration across UK, US, and European operations with different brand portfolios and distribution channels.

risks.title: Consumer discretionary spending pressure
risks.score_rationale: High interest rates and recession fears continue to impact consumer confidence and discretionary spending on fashion products.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K/20-F documents. Digital investments focus on e-commerce platforms, data analytics capabilities, and customer experience enhancements without explicit AI references.
